name: Bocconi University
summary: Private Milan university for economics, management, finance, politics, AI and law; ten English bachelor's, chosen by test score plus earlier grades.

ib.text: Full IB Diploma, 24+ points with 12 at HL, TOK, EE and CAS passed; no subjects required. An IB in English meets the English rule. Predicted grades are not used.

dates.label: Early session: last day for international applicants to sit the online Bocconi test
Early session closes, 15:00 Italian time; needs a Bocconi test by 24 Sep or a SAT/ACT
Winter session: last online Bocconi test date, international applicants (book 48h ahead)
Winter session closes, 15:00 Italian time (results mid March)

programmes.name: Economics
programmes.about: Economics on a strong quantitative base: statistics, maths, machine learning and econometrics applied to growth, inflation, inequality, health and climate.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your test score (55%) and your grades from the two school years before the final one (45%). Nothing else is read.

programmes.name: Finance
programmes.about: How the financial system works: capital markets, intermediaries, contracts and instruments, with a data-driven approach to financial decisions and risk.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your test score (55%) and your grades from the two school years before the final one (45%). Nothing else is read.

programmes.name: International Politics and Government
programmes.about: Political science in a small international class: politics, economics, management, law, history and quantitative methods, focused on designing and evaluating public policy.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your test score (55%) and your grades from the two school years before the final one (45%). Nothing else is read.

family.name: International Politics and Government
family.differs: A Bocconi degree, three years in Milan, in the regular Early and Winter sessions.

programmes.name: International Politics and Government, HEC-Bocconi double degree
programmes.about: Social science with in-depth data science and quantitative methods: three semesters at Bocconi and three at HEC Paris, ending with a bachelor's degree from each.
programmes.ib: Own selection: test score, earlier grades, a CV and motivation entered in the form, and a recorded video interview. Round III closes 27 April 2027.
programmes.selectionNote: Earlier school grades, a test score (SAT 1040+, ACT 19+ or Bocconi test 17/50+), CV and motivation, and a video interview. Three rounds.
programmes.closesNote: Using the Bocconi test? Its last sitting is in late January

family.name: International Politics and Government
family.differs: Two degrees, Bocconi and HEC Paris, half in each; its own selection with a video interview and a third round in April.

programmes.name: Management
programmes.about: How organisations plan, organise and manage their resources, across business functions such as logistics, marketing and finance, and across company types and markets.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your test score (55%) and your grades from the two school years before the final one (45%). Nothing else is read.

separateFrom.name: Management and Computer Science
separateFrom.reason: A different degree: data science and computing for managers, not general management.

separateFrom.name: Management for the Arts and Cultures
separateFrom.reason: A different degree: management applied to the arts, heritage and creative industries.

programmes.name: Management and Computer Science
programmes.about: Maths, statistics and computing for managers who use data: acquiring, organising and analysing data to support economic, managerial and financial decisions.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your test score (55%) and your grades from the two school years before the final one (45%). Nothing else is read.

programmes.name: Management for the Arts and Cultures
programmes.about: Management and economics combined with the arts and humanities, for museums, heritage, performing arts, publishing, music, film, fashion and design.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your test score (55%) and your grades from the two school years before the final one (45%). Nothing else is read.

programmes.name: Mathematical and Computing Sciences for Artificial Intelligence
programmes.about: Mathematics, computer science, physics and economics combined to build the tools behind artificial intelligence, for strongly maths-minded students.
programmes.ib: If you apply with the SAT you need 600+ in Math (ACT: 25+ in Math) to be considered for this programme.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your test score (55%) and your grades from the two school years before the final one (45%). Nothing else is read.

programmes.name: World Bachelor in Business
programmes.about: A four-year business degree with USC Marshall and HKUST: year one in Los Angeles, year two in Hong Kong, year three in Milan, year four at your choice of the three.
programmes.ib: Apply on the Common App (choose USC, then WBB, code 1485) by 1 November 2026, Early Decision or Early Action; predicted grades, essays and references count.
programmes.selectionNote: A joint committee reads your whole profile: coursework and grades, SAT/ACT (optional), activities, essays and counsellor or teacher references.
programmes.closesNote: Common App, Early Decision or Early Action

programmes.name: Bachelor in Global Law
programmes.about: Law for international advisory roles, mixed with business management, finance, economics and digital technology, with a focus on the global side of legal issues.
programmes.ib: Law School ranking: besides the Bocconi test, SAT or ACT, the Bocconi online test for Law and the LSAT (147+) are accepted here.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked separately from the other bachelor's, on your test score (55%) and your grades from the two school years before the final one (45%).

notes: Only your final grades from the third-last and second-last school years count (for a 2027 graduate, summer 2025 and summer 2026); predicted and final-year grades are not read.
You apply with a Bocconi online test, SAT or ACT score already in hand; each application costs €100 and can list up to four programmes.
Up to 50–55% of places on the English-taught programmes may go to international applicants.
